sources.title: The Geologic Enhanced Mapping System (GEMS) Prize Challenge — problem description
claims_verified: The target is fault presence with incomplete and potentially inaccurate public known-fault labels; new faults are expert-identified.
Initial private test labels and final expanded labels are distinct scoring rounds; the selected submission is reused.
The metric is distance-weighted Tversky with alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, and a triangular kernel with 300 m support.
Submission: one float32 GeoTIFF layer, EPSG:32611, 100 m resolution, matching bounds; values in [0,1]; outside the bounds null or NaN.
sources.limits: Public/private leaderboard values were not accessed. The official data-download tab redirects to login in this environment.

sources.title: Geologic Enhanced Mapping System (GEMS) Prize Official Rules
claims_verified: A valid entry uses a single GeoTIFF with a single raster layer at 100 m over the GeoDAWN study area.
The rules refer competitors to the competition website for format details and state three submissions per week.
Generative-AI use is allowed but must be disclosed in the narrative, including its extent and how it contributed to submission elements.
sources.limits: The competition interface was not used; submission/upload was not attempted. The user remains responsible for accurate authorship and results statements.

sources.title: INGENIOUS — Great Basin Regional Dataset Compilation, DOI 10.15121/1881483
claims_verified: The public CC-BY 4.0 compilation includes magnetotelluric/electrical-conductance maps and multiple other geoscience themes.
The listed conductance release describes five depth ranges spanning 2 to 200 km.
sources.limits: Individual raster bytes, effective spatial resolution, and exact GEMS-footprint coverage were not retrieved or checked.

sources.title: OPERA Surface Displacement from Sentinel-1 validated product, version 1
claims_verified: The product reports 30 m spatial posting and line-of-sight displacement from Sentinel-1 interferometric time-series analysis.
The collection has broad North American coverage and temporal extent beginning 2016-07-01; the page also describes the Sentinel data as 2016–2025.
sources.limits: A product-wide extent does not prove a usable granule/track for every GEMS cell; no granule selection or access test was run.
